news.title: Exploring AI’s Operational Implications in a Future U.S.-China Conflict: Initial Observations from the Camp(ai)gn Wargame
news.summary_en: The wargame Camp(ai)gn explores the military implications of artificial intelligence. This paper presents gameplay observations about how autonomous systems might shape the character of conflict, logic of escalation, and choices facing commanders.

news.title: AI, China, and the New Risks to U.S. Security: Q&A with Matan Chorev
news.summary_en: Matan Chorev is vice president and director of RAND Global and Emerging Risks. In this Q&A, he discusses some of the most consequential challenges facing the United States and the world.

news.title: Back to School: Three Big Challenges
news.summary_en: RAND's Heather Schwartz discusses three education trends to watch as students and teachers head back to the classroom: AI, cell phones, absenteeism.
